fusions.name: Felling Wedge
fusions.desc: A wedge-driving blow deals 28 damage, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Splinter Spray
fusions.desc: A chop into the ground throws 4 splinters in a spread out to 5 tiles. Each splinter deals 3 damage, with a 30% chance to leave its target [Bleeding] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Deadfall
fusions.desc: Props a cut log over a sharpened stake at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 18 seconds, and when an enemy comes within 2 tiles it drops and deals 24 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Widening Kerf
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on that enemy, up to 6. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: a blow strikes that enemy for 27% of your weapon damage per stack (163% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
